purpose: Separate caller claims from WASM-generated verification evidence and preserve verifier/reference provenance.

authorities.legacy_recordProof: caller-controlled legacy journal entry; not verifier authority
authorities.vector_receipt: WASM comparator authority over equality/tolerance relative to a caller-supplied reference
authorities.graph_receipt: WASM verifier authority using Burn CompiledGraph as the reference execution

workspaceVerifyVectorReceipt.mutation: AgentWorkspace verifier-receipt ledger after successful comparison

workspaceVerifyGraphReceipt.mutation: AgentWorkspace verifier-receipt ledger after Burn-backed graph verification

workspaceProofLedger.returns: legacy proofs, attestations, and compact verifier receipts as separate collections

runtime_subject.authority: execution context supplied by the Resolution↔Runtime bridge; verifier does not independently authorize it
runtime_subject.unbound: status=unbound remains valid for legacy/non-bridged execution
runtime_subject.program_binding: when runtime subject is bound, graph receipts require the exact CompiledGraph.programIdentity to have been registered by workspaceCompileForRuntimeSubject

fingerprint.security: not collision-resistant and not a cryptographic signature

policy.malformed_inputs: transport/validation error; no receipt is recorded
policy.receipt_import: forbidden; callers cannot inject a verifier receipt JSON into the internal ledger
policy.legacy_compatibility: recordProof remains available but must be interpreted as caller-controlled legacy state
policy.bound_subject_graph_receipt: fail closed before graph execution/receipt allocation unless exact programIdentity is bound to the workspace subject

invariants: caller attestation cannot create verifier authority
verifier receipts are created only by functions that execute the verifier
graph receipt reference is produced by Burn CompiledGraph execution
vector receipt reference remains explicitly caller-supplied
failed numerical comparisons are recorded as failed receipts rather than transport errors
invalid/non-finite/malformed inputs do not consume a verifier receipt id
programIdentity remains authoritative for exact compiled graph structural identity
graph receipt binds the observed numerical reference through reference_fingerprint because mutable weights/state are intentionally excluded from programIdentity
verifier receipts preserve the currently bound runtime subject context without upgrading that context into verifier authorization
bound-subject graph receipts cannot relabel a graph whose exact programIdentity is absent from the workspace subject binding set
programIdentity exact comparison is authoritative for subject-program binding; FNV fingerprints remain correlation metadata only
ResolutionEvidenceInbox preserves verifier/reference source labels but does not authenticate host-transported receipt fields or create Resolution state transitions

runtime_resolution_rejoin.graph_receipt: may be transported with source_authority=wasm_verifier, but ResolutionEvidenceInbox marks transport as host_structured_unverified and observation_only; the original runtime receipt remains authoritative
runtime_resolution_rejoin.vector_receipt: may be transported with source_authority=wasm_comparator and caller-supplied-reference semantics, but the inbox does not authenticate the host transport
runtime_resolution_rejoin.interpretation: receipt fields transported into the inbox are observations only; pass/fail does not create ResolutionDiagnostic or transition ResolutionWorkflow
